property_summary: For any caller, a successful lockInGuess call after a correct payment of 1 ether in the constructor must leave the guesses mapping entry updated; the mutant requires 2 ether so a call with 1 ether reverts and fails to update the entry.
change_summary: Replace `require(msg.value == 1 ether)` with `require(msg.value == 2 ether)` to change the required payment amount.
